messages:
nina: Opening follow-up for Halcyon Dedicated postmortem. Root cause: on-prem peering + asymmetric NAT behavior left routes orphaned; customer isolation lasted ~1h20. Need owners for remediation, checklist changes, and detection rules. @tomas @liya please take ops/network sides.

tomas: From packet traces: when NAT hit ephemeral-port wrap, return path chose a different egress and peer rejected due to missing expected source. Two things: (1) push a soft throttle + egress shaping as interim, (2) add a prefix reconciliation check to detect missing prefixes quickly.

liya: Will own detection and runbook. Proposed: poll peering adjacency every 30s, validate expected prefixes; if >2 misses -> run auto-collect (bgp snapshot, last-mgmt logs) and page SRE. ETA for prototype 2026-04-08.

quentin: I'll draft a customer-facing remediation plan and coordinate a firmware consult with Halcyon ops. Also propose adding a "conntrack/port-space" field to the onboarding form so we know device limits early. ETA 2026-04-05.

nina: Action items (owner -> ETA):
- tomas -> interim egress shaping config + test plan -> 2026-04-03
- liya -> prefix-reconciliation lambda + playbook -> 2026-04-08
- quentin -> customer comms + onboarding field change -> 2026-04-05
- infra -> tenant sweep for conntrack anomalies -> 2026-04-15

liya: I'll include a short checklist step: "verify onprem NAT ephemeral port space >= X and GR restart behavior". Add link to test script in PR.

tomas: Lab test of egress shaping reduced asymmetric flows by ~70% under synthetic load. I'll open draft PR: https://repo.redwood.internal/net/merge/6123 (draft).

infra-bot: Follow-up task created: INC-2067-12-HALC-FU assigned to infra-team. Reminder set for 2026-04-10.

quentin: Halcyon agreed to a maintenance window 2026-04-09 01:00-02:00 UTC for firmware probe + staged rollback plan. Will run canary on one PoP first.

liya: After staging validation I'll post checklist PR and update the private-deploy onboarding doc. Expect PR by 2026-04-07.

nina: Thanks team. Plan to reconvene 2026-04-10 16:00 PT to close items. If we confirm this pattern across multiple tenants, escalate to a platform guardrail ticket. Closing thread for now, will reopen with PR links and post-validation logs.
